hints.title: Total Product Invariant
hints.text: Both disjoint subsets must multiply to target, meaning the total product of the entire array must equal target squared.

hints.title: Bitmask Subset Generation
hints.text: With at most 12 elements, iterate through binary subsets from 1 to 2^n - 2.

hints.title: Early Product Pruning
hints.text: Multiply subset elements, breaking immediately if the running product exceeds target.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Small search space allows bitwise enumeration.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Arbitrary factorizations without product balance checks explore excessive candidates.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply the total product invariant check before searching subsets.
